title: Get started: reopen only for missing required answers; intro first run only; empty Next = Skip (decision #70)
head: fix/onboarding-required-only
body:
Bug (Braden): after saving his profile, he relaunched the Rig and Get started ran the whole setup again. Decision #70. Needs agent-core#26 (0.6.11).

**Cause:** the quiet-hours answer was saved blank (Next on an empty box sent `""`), so it stayed pending. The app reopens Get started for any pending question, and always starts with the 4 intro screens.

**Fix**
- `App.tsx`: the Get started tab appears only when some pending question has `required: true`.
- `Onboarding.tsx`: the intro screens show only when `first_run` is true.
- `Onboarding.tsx`: **Next on an empty answer counts as Skip** and sends nothing (text, list, people, or no ventures ticked).
- `serviceClient.ts`: reads `required` and `first_run`. A service older than #70 is treated as all-required and first-run, which is the old behaviour.
- `docs/local-api.md`, CHANGELOG.

**Tests** (each fails when its fix is removed):
- no Get started tab when only optional answers are pending;
- no intro when it isn't the first run;
- empty Next sends nothing and moves on.

```
npm run typecheck   → pass
eslint src tests    → pass
vitest run          → 14 files, 65 passed (3 runs)
npm run build       → pass
git diff --check    → clean
```

After both PRs merge, Braden's current profile (only quiet hours pending, which is optional) no longer reopens Get started.
